title: Case storytelling and strategy
short: From a pile of disputes to a story a judge can follow in minutes.
lead: We turn messy timelines, emails and disputes into a structured legal narrative a judge can understand in minutes.
get: A dated chronology tied to every exhibit
The questions your hearing will turn on
A plain-language outline of your story
note: Best when you have the facts but can't make them make sense.

title: Court document drafting
short: Motions, factums, affidavits, built to the rules.
lead: Hands-on drafting help and templates for motions, factums, affidavits, pleadings, notices of application and trial records that follow the court's rules.
get: Trial records, formatted to the rules
note: Drafting is done under a licensee on our team, within what that licence permits in your province.

title: Full-file review and audit
short: We read every page. Then we tell you what we found.
lead: We read every page of your file to find procedural traps, contradictions in the other side's filings and missing links in your evidence.
get: Contradictions cited to page and paragraph
A list of the evidence you still need
note: Often the right first step, even if you need nothing else.

title: Forensic accounting
short: Trace the money. Test the numbers the other side swore to.
lead: We trace assets, audit financial statements, test for income discrepancies and calculate or rebut damages.
note: Common in family, estate, shareholder and fraud disputes.

title: Handwriting and signature analysis
short: Disputed signature? Altered page? Find out before you allege it.
lead: We analyse forged, altered or disputed signatures and manipulated documents so you know what you can credibly say in court.
get: Signs of alteration or page substitution
Findings written for use in your case
note: If your matter needs a court-qualified expert, we'll tell you what the rules require.

title: Courtroom coaching and education
short: What to file, when to file it, and how to stand your ground.
lead: We demystify court procedure so you always know what to file, when to file it and how to present your argument.
note: You speak for yourself in court. We prepare you to do it.
